title: 15 high-value customers worth $20,838 look ready to leave
summary: They spent well before, then went quiet for 30+ days. A personal win-back recovers more than a broad discount blast.
action: Send a personal note plus one relevant offer to these 15 customers only.

title: Mobile checkout friction cost about $12,404 this week
summary: Revenue fell $22,552 week over week. Mobile is 62% of traffic, so when checkout stumbles there the whole week feels it.
action: Cut mobile checkout to 2 steps and switch on Apple Pay / Google Pay this week.

title: Selvedge Raw Jean is your quiet margin winner
summary: 67.1% margin and $7,927 profit, stronger than several louder bestsellers.
action: Feature it on the homepage and in email. Give it the creative budget bestsellers already get.

title: Harbor Textile Partners is tied to $7,414 in refunds (23% of return $)
summary: Returns cluster on one supplier more than the others. That usually points to packing, sizing guides or late inbound stock.
action: Open a quality review before the next PO and compare return reasons side by side.

title: Late delivery drove 20% of returns ($7,386)
summary: Customers who wait too long refund even when the product is fine. Clear delivery promises and shipping updates win this back.
action: Promise 'ships in 48h' only on pick-ready SKUs and send proactive tracking updates.

title: Paid search is $5,880 below last week
summary: Search usually converts cleaner than social. A dip often means wasted keywords or a landing page that no longer matches the promo.
action: Check brand vs non-brand split and pause terms returning under 2× ad spend.

title: Paid social lost $4,180 vs last week as creative ages out
summary: Paid social carries the mix. When the same ads run past a few days, spend keeps going while results shrink.
action: Pause creatives older than 3–4 days, rotate 2 new hooks and cap frequency.

title: Restock watch: Leather Strap Slide is your fastest seller
summary: 115 units and $14,373 revenue in 90 days. A stockout here hurts more than on long-tail SKUs.
impact_label: estimated loss if it stocks out
action: Confirm 4 weeks of cover with the supplier and set a reorder alert.
